answer_1.quote: We consider several knowledge-intensive NLP tasks, including Open-Domain Question Answering (ODQA), Open-Domain Dialogue (ODD), and Long-Form Question Answering (LFQA).
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for question answering tasks and responses for dialogue tasks.

answer_2.quote: For ODQA, we report the Exact Match (EM) scores ... For open-domain dialogue, we evaluate the models with F1 and ROUGE-L metrics ... for long-form question answering ... we report F1 and ROUGE-L metrics.
